name: National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Multiple Disabilities (NIEPMD)
evidence: The official NIEPMD homepage identifies the institute as operating under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, and labels national institutes under DEPwD as “Autonomous Bodies.”
notes: The supplied legacy hostname was unreachable; the current official NIEPMD domain was used to verify the same named institute.
Normal TLS verification returned curl error 60 for the managed proxy certificate chain; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests.
